package: SOP-8 (UTD Semiconductor / UMW rebrand designation; body D 4.80-5.00mm x E1 3.80-4.00mm, lead span E 5.80-6.20mm, pitch e 1.24-1.30mm - standard 8-lead SOIC/SOP-8 family; no JEDEC MO/MS code cited in this PDF)
description: UMW (UTD Semiconductor Co., Limited) AO4407A, P-Channel MOSFET, rebrand/second-source of the original Alpha & Omega AO4407A (a different LCSC part, C16072, already extracted for board sbuck-5v3a from the AOS Rev3 Jan-2008 datasheet - electrical figures differ between the two: this UMW datasheet, Nov.2024, 10 pages, rates ID=-14A vs AOS's -12A). Advanced trench technology, VDS=-30V, 25V gate rating, ultra-low gate charge; suitable for load-switch or PWM applications. Pb-free (RoHS, Sony 259).

layout_notes: No dedicated 'Layout Considerations' section is present in this datasheet - only the footnotes below the Thermal Characteristics / Electrical Characteristics tables (p.4, footnotes A-F) constrain how the rated currents/power apply.

Footnote A: RthetaJA is measured with the device mounted on a 1 in^2 FR-4 board with 2oz copper, in still air, TA=25C. 'The value in any given application depends on the user's specific board design' - i.e. the -14A/-11A continuous ID and 3.1W/2.0W PD ratings are only valid at or above that copper area; less copper derates both.
Footnote B: Power dissipation PD is based on TJ(MAX)=150C using the <=10s junction-to-ambient thermal resistance (RthetaJA typ 31 / max 40 C/W), not the steady-state figure.

Footnote D: RthetaJA (steady-state, typ 59 / max 75 C/W) is stated to equal RthetaJL (junction-to-lead, typ 16 / max 24 C/W) plus lead-to-ambient thermal impedance - i.e. copper at the drain leads (pins 5-8) is the primary heat-removal path; maximize copper area/pour at the drain pads for continuous-current operation.

Footnote C: Pulsed drain current IDM (-56A) and avalanche current IAS (-33A) are repetitive ratings limited by TJ(MAX)=150C, based on low frequency and duty cycle to keep initial TJ=25C - not continuous-duty figures.

Footnote F: The SOA and transient-thermal-impedance curves (Figs 9-11) are likewise characterized on the same 1 in^2 FR-4, 2oz-Cu, still-air board - same copper-area caveat applies to pulse-current/SOA headroom.
